# ascii.rest, vendored

`mount.js` (the canvas renderer), `banner.js` (block-letter banners) and `galaxy.js` (the galaxy piece) are the
built JavaScript of [ascii.rest](https://github.com/bas3line/ascii) by bas3line, version 0.4.0, commit
c556be4, MIT licensed (see LICENSE). They are copied unchanged from `dist/`.
